data.name: Version
data.comment: Under the application name in the About header; {0} = version number. Small text on one line.

data.name: Website
data.comment: Button in the About row that opens the studio website. Short: the row holds several buttons.

data.name: Donate
data.comment: Button in the About row that opens the studio donation page; also its screen-reader name. Short: a drawn cup sits beside it.

data.name: WhatsNew
data.comment: Button in the About row that shows the release notes of this version inside the window. Short: the row holds several buttons.

data.name: NotesFetching
data.comment: Status sentence in the release notes panel while the notes download. Ends with an ellipsis.

data.name: NotesFetchFailed
data.comment: Status sentence in the release notes panel when the download failed for any reason. Full stop.

data.name: NotesEmpty
data.value: Det er ingenting å vise for denne versjonen.
data.comment: Status sentence in the release notes panel when the published notes are empty. Full stop.

data.name: LibrariesCollapsed
data.comment: Toggle above the credited libraries while the list is hidden; the arrow at the end points down. LibrariesExpanded is the same toggle open: same wording.

data.name: LibrariesExpanded
data.comment: Toggle above the credited libraries while the list is shown; the arrow at the end points up. LibrariesCollapsed is the same toggle closed: same wording.

data.name: LibraryCredit
data.comment: One line per credited library; {0} = library name (a link when it has an address), {1} = author, {2} = what it is used for, {3} = licence identifier. Keep {0} where a reader meets the name first.

data.name: Footer
data.comment: Footer of the About card; {0} = year (digits), {1} = studio name. The middle dot separates the licence name.

data.name: CheckForUpdates
data.comment: Button under the About card that runs the application update check. Full width of a narrow window.

data.name: Close
data.comment: Screen-reader name of the About window close button, which shows only a cross.
